profile.headline: Software Engineer at Technisource
profile.summary:
DO-178B, Requirements derivation, Verification, Test (SDET). PROGRAMMER-ANALYST, and SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT. GPS and Navigation systems analysis.  ARINC 429/604. Development of embedded software with Ada. Software development with C. Vista, Windows7, Office.  Microsoft Visio.  UNIX.  VAX VMS, Fortran.  OOD and top-down structured design. GUI tools: X-Designer, others. Kalman Filters.  INTERNATIONAL LIAISON.  ASTRODYNAMICS and AVIONICS: Kepler Equations, Orbital and suborbital motion, Cassini spacecraft, MD-11, LAMPS, F15E, TitanIV, C17. IV&V. SIMULATION: Nav IRU, 1553 bus communications, flight trainers. TIDSP2833, Flash28335_API_V210 library, VME backplane. Motorola 603e PPC, MPC. DOD-Std 2167A, MilStd 1553B, 1815A.
California CBEST Certification: ID#: 41623104

positions.title: Development Engineer
positions.description:
Aircraft Component Control Unit (contract between Emteq and Honda).  Certification of ACCU for DO-178B Level C.  Accomplishments included the following:  
•	Ran HLR tests on AVRStudio simulator and JTAG on circuit board (ATMega1284P 8 bit MCU).  Used Linux on Cygwin terminal to manage test code.
•	Wrote 16 bit CRC BIT and Internal SRAM BIT.  Formulated derived requirements on SDD(LLR) and SRS(HLR) for BITs.  Wrote tests for BIT failure to be included in SWVCP (S/W verification cases and procedures).  IDE AVR Studio, C language.
•	Calculated worst case timing through polling software (ARINC 429 messages drive analog signals and digital switches that control lighting)
•	Derived memory map to be included in SRS.
•	Supervised statement coverage effort (performed by intern). Wrote report to certify 100% statement coverage.
•	Formulated derived requirements for Health Monitor Output for 4 error conditions: fuse bit errors, inconsistent ID, erroneous ID and loss of ARINC communication during normal operation.
•	Ran PC Lint to enforce MISRA-C rules.  Wrote Software Coding Standard.
•	Was responsible for a version of the SWDD and SRS.

positions.title: Sofware/Systems Engineer
positions.description: Helicopter Terrain Awareness and Warning System (SANDEL ST3400H HeliTAWS) migration from DO-178B Level C to Level B.  Certification of HTAWS at Level B.  Managed team of 2, responsible for tracking schedule with MS Project. Traceability established from System Requirements Spec (SRC) to functions. Bottom-up analysis determined missing LLR; exercising existing HLR tests along with BullsEye coverage tool determined decisions not covered.  Modified existing HLR (black box) tests and added small number of white box tests as necessary to achieve 100% decision coverage for Level B.  Ensured each LLR was tested. Exercised black box and white box tests to demonstrate required decision coverage.  IDE was Visual Studio.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Derivation of SWRD and SWDD requirements from CRS.  Application Initiated Built-in Tests, communication with On-Board Maintenance System, Embraer 450/500 aircraft.  ARINC 604 Communications Protocol, interactive and automatic modes.  Visio.  Wrote SWDD requirements for ARINC 604 protocol extension of ARINC 429 communication link between MPC processor and the On-board Maintenance System.  RTCA/DO-178B Level A .

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Embraer 550 Aircraft: Wrote Software Requirements Specification (SWRS) and Software Requirements Design document (SWDD) for Hardware-Software interface (Flight controls hardware: TI DSP and host FPGA & following ICDs – TTP, CMDL, CCDL, MCDL, ARINC-429, AIO, WDT, and following drivers – SPI, SCI, XINTF, CPU Timers, FPGA, SRAM, FLASH, NVM).  Used DOORS for requirements management, Microsoft Visio for flowcharts.  DO-178B Level A monitoring software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: A400 Auxiliary Power Unit Controller (APUC): manual and automated testing at DO-178B Level A.  Automated tests using Visual Basic. Manual tests using ICE.  Development of PSAC and other planning docs.  Code review in C (CL05). Module testing (CL09). Test Procedure detailed reviews (CL08A&B).

positions.title: Verification Engineer
positions.description: Reverse engineering activities for embedded software on P8A, C130J and C130AMP programs.  Verification of software requirements test procedures (P8A and C130J) re DO-178B Level B. Software requirements capture (C130AMP Video Monitor).  Impact analysis.  Worked with ANSI C and Ada 83/95 code.  Worked with client-server sockets, stream and datagram protocols; MOS drivers, core and BSP code.  Target computers included GPM800. P9, P10 (3D Labs GPU).

positions.title: Verification Engineer
positions.description:
Verification of software requirements, low level design and test scripts for sensors in the braking system on B787 Dreamliner.  DO-178B Compliant, Level A.  CM and Change Synergy tools employed.  Liaison with and travel to Hindustan Computers Limited (HCL) in Bangalore, India about 50% of 2008 to support HCL development and test personnel.
DO-178B testing levels:
DO-178B Level A and Level D testing
For Level A, Unique-Cause MC/DC testing, both automated and manual
For Level D, automated black box testing that expected results occur per the requirements
Automated testing using:
Green Hills Multi
Code Composer Studio
Microsoft Visual C++ IDEs.  
Automated testing consists of running test scripts on a Triakis simulator or a BSCU or ARDC platform using the following IDEs:
For BSCU Software Integration, Microsoft Visual C++ on Triakis simulator
For BSCU Hardware/Software Integration, Green Hills Multi on MPC565
For ARDC Hardware/Software Integration, Code Composer on TMS320-F2812
Manual testing using Green Hills Multi (integrated into the Triakis tool).
CM tools used: 
CM
Change Synergy
ERooms
Team One
Hardware platforms: 
TMS320-F2812 (Texas Instruments DSP)
MPC565 (Motorola Power PC)
Static and dynamic analysis using the LDRA Test Bed

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Derivation of software requirements for Intelligent Munitions System, stepwise refinement process.  CMMI level 5, ISO-AS9100, DO-178B Compliant, DOORS for requirements traceability.  Developed application software in C for Intelligent Munitions System, communications layer and display processing, using Green Hills Integrity IDE.  Wrote unit tests for these applications.
Computer Systems Analyst, Range Safety, Vandenberg AFB.  Continuation of previous employment from January 2003.  Minuteman III post-flight analysis designed to certify new sensor equipment.  Developed simulations in C for Kalman filter tracking algorithms that determine instantaneous impact points (IIIP).  Simulated algorithms for coordinate transformations (ECEF to Geodetic), non-linear least squares fits, spline interpolation, Kepler orbital elements from position and velocity, and IIP determination.  Developed efficient method for calculating eigenvalues of 3x3 symmetric matrices and short geodesic distances.  Developed simulation of GPS L1 signal processing concerning suborbital/orbital vehicles and transmission of these signals via S-band to ground processing (GTP) units.  This permitted diagnosis of anomalous behavior of GTP units.  Developed Kalman Filter Introductory Course using MATLAB.

positions.title: Computer Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Analyzed and critiqued designs for advanced range safety software.  Reviewed RSAIIA software (Ada) and monitored peer reviews.  

May 2002 * January 2003: Contract Software Engineer at Redstone Arsenal.   Assigned to Comanche RAH-66 Project Manager.  Liaison between Comanche PM and Boeing Philadelphia, Boeing Wichita and Harris Melbourne vendors.  Performed IV&V activities on design documents, software for the flight computer Operating System and embedded software in a memory recording system.  Activities included tracking metrics. Extensive travel involved.  PSM Insight tracking tool. Comanche project was cancelled.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of the CoRE Project.  Responsible for writing and executing test procedures for the Board Support Package of a 603e PPC using the LynxOS (POSIX compliant) operating system.  Test cases developed according to the DO-178B standard.  Level A (Safety Critical).  Used ClearCase for test development, DOORS for requirements traceability, C++ with g++ compiler for coding and CodeTest and PowerTap for testing.  Developed a character device driver to be dynamically installed.  The device was a protected area of memory (interrupt & timer systems).  Interrupt handlers linked to existing handlers for test purposes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Assigned at Raytheon to Firefinder Project.  Developed SRS for Mission Operations Program.  Defined messages for communication between Operations Computer and Radar Computer.  Developed Representation clauses and C structures for messages on either side of TCP/IP ethernet comm link.  Developed radar auto-censoring and location averaging requirements.  Modeled comm link between Solaris Unix and single board computer for testing.  APEX Ada, Green Hills C++.                                                                           Assigned at Raytheon to HIIP NATO Greek Air Defense contract.  Developed software (Ada 83) for Universal Protocol Converter diagnostics.  Developed database scripts using RDO script language on VAX VMS. This was used to convert database suitable for one air defense site to another. Developed scripts for Data Link Simulator operation on both VAX and ALPHA (Compac) target machines.  Wrote test procedure for Track Registration S/W.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Ada83 Development using ActivAda compiler on NT for safety critical applications at railroad crossings.  Set up McCabe Tool Set and the Intersolv PVCS version control system for safety applications at railroad crossings.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Prototyping client-server communications for Cruise Missile Systems in ANSI C using layer over Unix low level services. Wrote tests in Ada95.  Platform is PC with NT operating system using a Unix window.  APEX Ada95, ANSI C. Generated Teamwork model (functional decomposition) for Tomahawk Employment Support (Communications CSC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Debugged and integrated coordinate transformation functions that convert between geodetic, MGRS and UTM coordinates for various spheroids.  Developed and coded functions using the Molodensky Abridged Transformation and multiple regression equations that convert between datums for geodetic coordinates.
Developed R/T examples in Ada for Operating Environment (OE) functions using APEX.  OE has two layers, the lower functioning as a binding to VxWorks, the upper layer serving as an interface to real time applications.  Wrote Users and Reference manual describing OE. Wrote and executed unit and functional tests for OE Shared Memory functions.  McCabe and Testmate tools used. Developed string utilities in Ada for A3 vehicle project using APEX on Sun Sparc. 15 month limit for contractors.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Ada 83 development from Matlab design. OOD approach used. Signal processing algorithms: Butterworth filter, interpolation and decimation of radar signal, feature extraction, feature matching.  Development on SGI and Sun Sparc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Fixed Price Contract, 1099.  Concurrent with Motorola position.
Developed Motif GUI for communications application. Used XDesigner.  Programmed callbacks in ANSI C.  Interface included drawing areas, scrolled lists, maps and handling of resizing and exposure events.  Callback code written in C.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote simulation in C for Inertial Reference Unit using Hemispheric Resonator Gyroscopes for Cassini project.  Simulated communication on 1553A bus with application-specific protocol.
Developed several simulations in Ada to test capability of navigation system to compute distance, bearings, cross-track points and cross-track distances on earth's surface.  Used Alsys Ada.  Sun with Open Windows.  Target 80486 machine.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Unit testing of navigation software for TSAM Air Force project.  Used in-house provided ATE tool to instrument test drivers.  Ada, VAX VMS, accessed by remote login from Sun Sparc workstation.  Development of tool in Ada to manipulate files of error messages; DODStd 2167A.  Air Force cancelled project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed MOTIF MMI using X-Designer and UIM/X  2.5.  Wrote Ada callbacks using Alsys Ada on HP9000/300 and /700.  Wrote client and server software in ANSI C using  OSF DCE  environment.  Responsible for implementing requirements for System Manager in Maneuver Control System.

educations.schoolName: DREXEL U., U. OF CENTRAL FLORIDA, U. of PA
